listing.name: Metal Gear Rising: Revengeance (Xbox 360) — Zandatsu (dfdx047)
listing.summary: Experimental rendering options and known issues are documented. A full playthrough remains unconfirmed. See below for original-file requirements and setup. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Provide your own Metal Gear Rising: Revengeance (Xbox 360) Xbox 360 disc ISO. USA/Europe; title 4B4E080A; retain ISO after import.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Install Zandatsu APK and select own USA/Europe ISO; validation reads it in place, so retain the ISO.

warnings: Experimental rendering options and known issues are documented. A full playthrough remains unconfirmed.
Portcove has not confirmed setup, gameplay, saves or updates for this experimental port.

references.title: Use the Zandatsu Android APK
references.instruction: Install Zandatsu-v1.3.apk on ARM64 with Android 11 or later and Vulkan 1.3. Open the app and accept its suggested graphics profile or choose one yourself. In Home, open Game files and import your own USA or Europe Xbox 360 ISO. Keep it where you selected it. In Drivers, install and enable the driver if the app asks for one. Tap Play. Use the app to export or restore saves. The publisher says installing its newer APK over the older one preserves game files, saves and settings.
